title: Head of Finance, Brazil
description:
CONMED Corporation is a progressive, global medical device company, operating in 20 countries. Through thoughtful leadership, innovation and teamwork, we are changing the future of healthcare. Our 3,500 employees worldwide make meaningful contributions, positively impact the business, and advance in their careers as our company and product portfolio grows.

We are a leader in Orthopedics, General Surgery, Gynecology, Gastroenterology, Pulmonology, and Anesthesiology and our employees enjoy challenging and diverse job opportunities across these varied specializations. CONMED is headquartered in the United States. Our international presence includes more than 20 locations throughout Canada, Europe, Australia, Latin America, Asia, North America, and the Middle East.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Finance Director for Brazil is responsible for leading all financial operations, ensuring full compliance with local regulations, strengthening internal controls, optimizing financial performance, developing and supporting strategic business objectives. This role is pivotal in elevating governance, audit readiness, and operational discipline across the Brazilian organization.

This role oversees FP&A, Controllership, Reporting, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Internal Controls, Compliance, and Financial Governance, while partnering closely with the Country Manager and regional/global Finance leadership to drive sustainable growth, profitability, strong governance and disciplined execution.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic & Financial Leadership

  • Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with corporate objectives and Brazil's dynamic economic and regulatory environment.
  • Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, cash planning, and long-range planning processes for Brazil.
  • Serve as a strategic partner to the Country Manager and senior leadership team, providing actionable insights to influence commercial, operational, and organizational decisions.
  • Monitor market trends, FX volatility, reimbursement dynamics, inflationary pressures, and competitor behavior to inform financial strategy.

Financial Reporting, Compliance & Audit Readiness

  • Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual closing processes, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and timely reporting under Brazilian GAAP, IFRS, and corporate accounting standards (including US GAAP, if applicable).
  • Ensure complete, timely, and compliant statutory reporting, tax filings, SPED obligations (ECD/ECF), and other regulatory submissions.
  • Lead the Brazil Audit Remediation Plan, ensuring closure of all audit findings (high/medium/low risk) within established timelines.
  • Strengthen governance, documentation discipline, and financial process transparency to achieve "audit-ready, always" standards.
  • Manage external relationships with auditors (Big 4), tax authorities, banks, and regulatory bodies, representing the company with professionalism and financial rigor.

Treasury, Cash Flow & Working Capital Management

  • Own end-to-end cash flow, liquidity planning, and working capital performance (AR, AP, inventory).
  • Lead banking relationships, credit facility management, financial instruments, FX operations, and covenant monitoring.
  • Optimize capital structure, credit utilization, hedging strategies, and funding needs in alignment with corporate Treasury.
  • Drive improvements in collections, DSO, inventory turns, and payment terms to enhance cash generation.

Performance Management & Business Partnering

  • Deliver comprehensive financial analysis, including P&L performance, balance sheet quality, KPI trends, pricing, and margin enhancement opportunities.
  • Evaluate commercial strategies, business cases, investments, and distributor economics across franchises, customers, and Brazil geographies.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and Operations to improve pricing governance, cost-to-serve, product mix optimization, and portfolio profitability

Internal Controls, Governance & Risk Management

  • Design, implement, and continuously strengthen internal controls aligned with SOX, corporate governance frameworks, and Brazilian regulatory requirements.
  • Lead governance of Fixed-asset tracking and mobility controls, Inventory accuracy, reconciliations, and reporting reliability (including 3PL and distributor consignment)
  • Build and maintain a comprehensive risk register, governance cadence, and audit calendar.

Systems, ERP & Digital Finance

  • Lead optimization and governance of ERP and reporting systems, improving data integrity, and reporting accuracy.
  • Implement analytics and BI tools to enhance management dashboards, forecasting, and business decision-making.

Team Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing Finance organization across Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, and Controls.
  • Build strong bench strength and raise capability in financial governance, technical accounting, tax, and analytics.
  • Lead the team through transformational change, strengthening culture, accountability, and execution discipline
  • Foster effective cross-functional partnerships with Operations, Commercial, Supply Chain, and Service teams.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

  • Minimum 7–10 years in senior finance leadership roles (Finance Director, Country Controller, CFO, or equivalent) within multinational environments.
  • Proven experience in a similar leadership role or demonstrated potential to successfully assume such responsibilities.
  • Proven track record in governance turnarounds, internal controls design, and complex compliance environments.
  • Significant experience managing cash flow, working capital, treasury, and banking relationships.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Accounting, FP&A, Tax (including indirect taxes), Treasury, and statutory reporting.
  • Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, or medical devices preferred; understanding of distributors and regulated markets is a plus.

Skills & Competencies

  • Deep understanding of Brazil's financial, tax, and regulatory landscape.
  • Strong command of Brazilian GAAP, IFRS, and corporate reporting frameworks including US GAAP
  • Advanced analytical thinking with ability to translate data into insights and influence senior decision-makers.
  • Strong systems orientation, with hands-on ERP experience (SAP/Oracle) and BI/reporting tools.
  • Exceptional communication skills in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken.
  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to drive accountability, lead change, and elevate organizational capability.
  • High degree of integrity, assertiveness, discipline, and ownership in managing financial governance.

Education & Credentials

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field (required).
  • MBA or advanced degree in Finance, Controllership, or related field (preferred).
  • Professional certification such as CRC, CPA, CMA, or equivalent strongly preferred.
  • Additional credentials in internal controls, audit, or compliance are a plus.

title: Viral video content creator
description:
Looking for a Viral Video Scriptwriter + Editor who can consistently create viral-style performance video ads using AI tools at scale. You will own the output like it's your channel, not a "tasks" role.

We run performance marketing campaigns and need a steady pipeline of fresh, high-converting video creatives for the US consumer.

Mission for this job

Own the end-to-end creative pipeline for short-form video ads:

  • Research the market and audience
  • Write scripts that hook hard and hold attention
  • Edit fast, clean videos using AI + simple editing tools
  • Ship volume, learn from results, and iterate daily
What success looks likeFirst 30 days
  • Learn our offers, compliance guardrails, and what "good" looks like for us.
  • Deliver a consistent daily output of scripts + edited videos (with clear naming and organization).
  • Build a repeatable workflow using AI tools for speed (script, voice, visuals, editing, captions).
  • Show you can research the US consumer and write in natural, native-sounding English.
By 90 days
  • Ship a reliable volume of creatives every week with clear variation by hook, angle, and structure.
  • Consistently produce multiple "winners" per month (videos we can scale spend behind).
  • Maintain a simple testing system: what you tried, what worked, what failed, and what to do next.
  • Become independent: you don't wait for perfect direction to move.
By 12 months
  • Fully own a creative machine that feeds our ad accounts nonstop.
  • Have a documented system another creator could follow.
  • Be the go-to person for viral ad formats, hooks, and creative strategy across offers.
What you will do
  • Write short-form ad scripts (UGC style, narration, simple scenes, strong hooks).
  • Do research (audience pains, language, objections, comments, competitor ads).
  • Edit videos in CapCut (or similar) and ship finished assets ready to launch.
  • Use AI tools to generate footage, b-roll, voice, captions, and variations fast.
  • Create lots of iterations: new hooks, new openings, new pacing, new visuals.
  • Organize deliverables cleanly (folders, versions, naming, notes).
Who you are
  • You have a portfolio of viral videos, ad creatives, or short-form edits.
  • You have strong English and can write like a real US consumer talks.
  • You understand basic copywriting: hook, problem, proof, offer, CTA.
  • You can edit quickly in CapCut (or similar) and keep pacing tight.
  • You've used AI tools to create videos at scale (not just one-offs).
  • You move fast, learn fast, and you care more about output and results than comfort.
Core values

Resourcefulness – You figure things out with minimal help.

Perfectly acceptable over perfection – Ship fast, then improve.

Constructive disagreement – Challenge ideas to get to the truth.

Kind, not nice – Honest feedback that helps people win long term.

Growth mindset – Learn from misses, don't repeat mistakes.

Full ownership – Act like the outcome is on you.

Offer

Competitive pay + profit share based on skill and output, with clear growth as you produce consistent winners.

Apply

Email

with:

  • Your portfolio (required if you have it)
  • A short note on your AI + editing workflow
  • 2–3 examples you're most proud of and why they worked

If you don't have a portfolio but you're sure you can win in this role, email anyway and explain your background plus how you'll prove yourself fast.

title: Bolsista Doutor em Tecnologia - Simplifica Data - Inteligência e desenvolvimento de projetos | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

A SIMPLIFICA DATA atua no desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em dados, Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning, transformando informações em eficiência, automação e suporte qualificado à tomada de decisão. Com foco em aplicações de alto impacto, a empresa combina engenharia, tecnologia e visão de produto para entregar soluções robustas, escaláveis e alinhadas a desafios reais.

Neste projeto, a atuação será voltada à aplicação de IA/ML para otimizar a análise de dados e desenvolvimento de projetos, desenvolvendo uma solução robusta em produção e evoluindo essa base tecnológica para um produto inovador, escalável e com potencial de mercado.

Se você é doutor nessa área e quer aplicar IA/ML em um projeto de alto impacto, com potencial real de virar produto, venha fazer parte.

Projeto: Transformação de projetos em Inovação de Mercado: Aplicação de IA/ML para Otimização e análise de dados.

Formação Acadêmica:

Engenharias com doutorado em áreas técnicas

(Computação, Estatística, Matemática Aplicada, Ciência de Dados ou Engenharias correlatas)

We produce some of the world's best-loved brands: M&M's, SNICKERS, TWIX, MILKY WAY, DOVE, PEDIGREE, ROYAL CANIN, WHISKAS, EXTRA, ORBIT, 5TM, SKITTLES, BEN'S ORIGINAL, and COCOAVIA. Alongside our consumer brands, we proudly take care of half of the world's pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses such as Banfield Pet HospitalsTM, BluePearl, Linnaeus, AniCura, VCATM and Pet PartnersTM. Headquartered in McLean, VA, Mars operates in more than 80 countries. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our 160,000 Diverse Associates to act daily towards creating the world we want tomorrow.

The Lead Data Platform Architect is instrumental in delivering scalable, repeatable and agile data and platform architectures to unlock and drive business value across Finance, Commercial, R&D, MGS Labs and Innovation:

As the Lead Data Platform Architect in the Enterprise Data & Platform team, your key responsibilities are as follows:

TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY AND LEADERSHIP

  • Lead the definition and execution of data architecture strategies across multiple business domains and data platforms.
  • Drive the development of scalable, integrated data models and architectures across raw, trusted, and harmonized zones.
  • Define and execute the data product strategy for assigned business areas in collaboration with analytics and business teams.
  • Act as a thought leader and trusted advisor, supporting teams in understanding business objectives, data requirements, processes, and enabling technologies.
  • Ensure all data architecture efforts are aligned with the broader business vision and strategic priorities and provide architectural oversight across delivery initiatives.
  • Collaborate with other data architects to ensure consistent and integrated use of data assets across the organization.
  • Identify cross-segment and cross-function data dependencies or issues and lead resolution efforts.
  • Provide strategic guidance on data domains, process analysis, data analysis, and modelling techniques.
  • Mentor and coach solution / data architects and engineers to build internal data architecture capability.
  • Advocate for best practices, tools, and methods related to data architecture.
  • Ensure understanding and compliance of data protection policies, security policies, and GDPR

DELIVERABLE INVOLVEMENT & OWNERSHIP

  • Reference Architectures: Own and maintain reusable architectural patterns
  • High-Level Designs (HLDs): Review and approve HLDs from Solution Architects and 3rd parties
  • Key Design Decisions (KDDs): Own and govern major architectural decisions for alignment with the Architecture Review Board and beyond
  • Architecture Option Assessments: Lead decisioning on tooling, modelling, and patterns

DATA & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE OWNERSHIP

  • Develop and maintain current and future state data architectures, models, and roadmaps.
  • Promote awareness and understanding of data architectures across the organization.
  • Review and validate high-level models and reference architecture libraries
  • Approve changes to shared or enterprise-wide data models

Knowledge and Experience

ESSENTIAL:

  • Previous experience as a Senior Data or Platform Architect essential
  • Proven experience as a senior data or platform architect, or similar leadership role in data & platform strategy.
  • Strong background in data modelling, architecture frameworks, and modern data integration methods.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-based data platforms (Azure) and tools (Databricks, SQL, ADF etc) as well as analytics solutions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and align across business and technology functions.
  • Experience building and evolving data & platform architectures that scale and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Passion for coaching and enabling others with a collaborative leadership approach.
  • Knowledgeable in Data Source systems (eg. SAP) and Data Lake technology
  • Stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Fluent in writing and speaking English

DESIRED:

  • Previous experience in CPG industry would be ideal
  • Experience at operating in a complex global matrix organisation
  • Experience at collaborating with cross-functional partners
  • High drive for results and an ability to work with minimum input

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we're striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including a company bonus.

title: Cientista de Dados Sr (IA Generativa)
description:
A BR Media Group é um hub de conteúdo referência no mercado para a economia de criadores, tem mindset data-driven e lidera soluções de influência e conteúdo para as principais marcas do mundo.

Procuramos uma pessoa para atuar como Cientista de Dados SR e AI para compor nossa equipe de Dados e Inovação, atuando diretamente no coração de nossas operações de marketing de influência e no desenvolvimento de produtos que irão revolucionar o mercado.

Se você é apaixonado por dados, machine learning e IA Generativa, entende o potencial dessas tecnologias para transformar o mercado de mídias sociais e criadores de conteúdo, e tem um perfil proativo, analítico e orientado a resultados, queremos conhecer você!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Essa pessoa será responsável por liderar nosso roadmap de desenvolvimento de produtos internos de AI e ML:

  • Liderar e executar o roadmap estratégico de Data Science e AI, desenvolvendo produtos internos que irão revolucionar nossa operação e a forma como entregamos valor.
  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de vida dos projetos (end-to-end), desde a concepção e coleta de dados (Engenharia de Dados) até o deployment e monitoramento dos modelos (MLOps).
  • Desenvolver e implementar soluções de Inteligência Artificial Generativa (GenAI) para otimizar processos internos e criar novas ferramentas para criadores e marcas (ex: análise preditiva de conteúdo, assistentes de briefing, etc.).
  • Criar modelos de machine learning para resolver desafios de negócios, como: previsão de performance de campanhas, sistemas de recomendação de influenciadores (matchmaking), análise de sentimento em larga escala e detecção de tendências.
  • Projetar e gerenciar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT), garantindo a qualidade, disponibilidade e integração dos dados provenientes de diversas fontes (APIs de redes sociais, dados internos, etc.).
  • Colaborar diretamente com as equipes de Produto, Marketing e Operações para entender as necessidades de negócios e traduzi-las em soluções técnicas viáveis.
  • Analisar e extrair insights de grandes volumes de dados (estruturados e não estruturados) do ecossistema de mídias sociais.
  • Apresentar resultados e descobertas complexas de forma clara e acionável para stakeholders (lideranças e equipes não técnicas).

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de Data Science e Machine Learning, com um portfólio de projetos aplicados.
  • Proficiência em Python e suas principais bibliotecas de dados (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn).
  • Experiência prática com frameworks de Deep Learning (ex: TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções com LLMs (Large Language Models), fine-tuning, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e ferramentas como LangChain ou similares.
  • Conhecimento sólido em SQL e experiência prática com bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais.
  • Experiência em engenharia de dados, construção de pipelines (ETL) e orquestração de jobs (ex: Airflow).
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita, com capacidade de "traduzir" o técnico para o negócio.
  • Perfil analítico, focado em resolução de problemas e orientado a resultados.
  • Experiência com plataformas de nuvem (GCP, AWS ou Azure) e suas ferramentas de AI/ML.

Diferenciais (Qualificações Desejáveis):

  • Experiência prévia em empresas do mercado Publicitário, MarTech ou Marketing de Influência.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de MLOps (ex: MLflow, Kubeflow) e deploy de modelos (ex: Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados (ex: Looker Studio, Power BI, Tableau).

title: Lead Training Consultant - SAP IBP & ePPDS
description:
About Company::

Bristlecone is a supply chain and business analytics advisor, serving customers across a wide range of industries. Rated by Gartner as among the top ten system integrators in the supply chain space, we are uniquely positioned to solve contemporary business problems, with supply chain and analytics focus as our advantage. We have been a trusted partner and advisor to many leading, globally recognized companies such as Applied Materials, Exxon Mobil, Flextronics, LSI Logic, Mahindra, Motorola, Nestle, Palm, Qatar Petroleum, Ranbaxy, Unilever and Whirlpool and many others.

Role Overview:

Language Required- Spanish Speaking

Should be open to travel to Mexico on needed basis

Role Objective

The Lead Training Consultant will be responsible for the end-to-end educational lifecycle of our digital supply chain transformation. This role requires a unique individual who can not only configure SAP IBP and ePPDS modules but also translate complex technical processes into comprehensive training programs for diverse business audiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Training Strategy: Conduct comprehensive Training Needs Analysis (TNA) to identify skill gaps and design a global curriculum covering SAP IBP (Demand, S&OP, Response & Supply) and ePPDS.
  • Content Development: Create high-quality, multi-format training materials including Instructor-Led Training (ILT) decks, Quick Reference Guides (QRGs), video tutorials, and interactive eLearning modules.
  • Hands-on Facilitation: Deliver engaging training sessions to Super Users and End Users, utilizing real-world business scenarios in a dedicated training environment.
  • Environment Management: Manage and maintain the SAP training landscape (Sandbox), ensuring master data is refreshed and aligned for practical hands-on labs.
  • Post-Go-Live Support: Provide critical Hypercare support and refresher training post-deployment to ensure high system adoption and user proficiency.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Technical Mastery: Deep functional knowledge of SAP IBP (specifically Order-Based Planning) and ePPDS (embedded Production Planning & Detailed Scheduling) in S/4HANA.
  • Training Expertise: Proven experience in end-to-end training delivery for large-scale SAP implementations, from curriculum design to final assessment.
  • Process Knowledge: Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, capacity planning, and detailed production scheduling.
  • Communication: Exceptional ability to simplify complex technical concepts for non-technical users.
  • Certification: SAP IBP or SCM Professional certification is highly preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Successful execution of the global training calendar within project timelines.
  • High user adoption rates and positive training effectiveness scores.
  • Minimal post-go-live support tickets related to "lack of knowledge" or process errors

title: Operations Manager
description:
About the Role:

A growing international betting operator is seeking a results-driven and highly structured Deputy Operations Manager to support the expansion of their retail sports betting operations in Brazil. Based in João Pessoa, this leadership position will play a critical role in implementing operational strategies, managing cross-functional support teams, and ensuring consistent service delivery across multiple sites. The role combines oversight of technology deployment, logistics, procurement, facilities, compliance, and security operations in a fast-paced and regulated industry.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Operational Leadership & Execution

  • Manage daily operations across retail locations, including POS, agent networks, and kiosks.
  • Supervise infrastructure setup and ensure systems and devices operate efficiently at all sites.
  • Coordinate interdepartmental efforts to align with business goals and maintain continuity.
  • Technology & Systems Integration
  • Oversee local deployment of technical solutions and platforms.
  • Lead integrations with payment providers, CPF verification systems, and compliance APIs.
  • Ensure systems meet national standards and regulatory certifications (e.g., GLI 13/16/33, LOTEP).
  • Monitor system reliability, data integrity, and uptime across operational platforms.
  • Procurement, Logistics & Import Operations
  • Lead end-to-end logistics, from supplier management and purchasing to customs compliance.
  • Authorize procurement activities within established approval frameworks.
  • Handle supplier negotiations to secure cost-effective, high-quality services.
  • Manage importation processes, ensuring all materials meet legal and regulatory standards.
  • Inventory, Warehousing & Dispatch
  • Monitor inventory levels and material flow across all operational hubs.
  • Enforce warehouse protocols for receiving, storing, and distributing goods.
  • Maintain accurate records and traceability for stock and movement control.
  • Fleet, Facilities & Maintenance
  • Oversee vehicle availability, usage, and preventive maintenance for operational fleets.
  • Supervise construction, renovation, and ongoing maintenance of physical locations.
  • Manage upkeep of generators, HVAC systems, power supply, and core IT infrastructure.
  • Ensure contractors meet quality, time, and cost expectations.
  • Safety, Security & Risk Mitigation
  • Lead on-site physical security efforts, including guards, access control, and patrols.
  • Ensure adherence to fire safety and workplace safety standards.
  • Respond to and document incidents related to theft, vandalism, or other safety breaches.
  • Conduct regular audits of safety protocols and asset protection measures.
  • Compliance & Internal Controls
  • Enforce operational policies aligned with AML, KYC, LGPD, and internal control standards.
  • Support audits by providing necessary operational records and data.
  • Track and report performance metrics around operational efficiency and system uptime.
  • Generate detailed reports for leadership and headquarters.
  • Team Leadership & Development
  • Supervise cross-functional teams in operations, logistics, security, and maintenance.
  • Collaborate with HR to address staffing needs, performance management, and training.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, safety, and continuous process improvement.

Desired Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, IT, Business, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 7 years' experience in operations or logistics, ideally in gaming, fintech, retail, or similarly regulated sectors.
  • Demonstrated success managing import processes, supplier relations, and inventory systems.
  • Hands-on experience with rolling out technology solutions and managing infrastructure in the field.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian compliance standards including LOTEP, LGPD, AML/KYC, and GLI certifications.
  • Strong financial skills with a focus on budget control and cost efficiency.
  • Fluent in both Portuguese and English.
  • Proven leadership ability and organizational skills in a multi-site, fast-growth environment.
  • Highly detail-oriented, execution-focused, and adaptable under pressure.

title: International Treasury Specialist
description:
Forno de Minas is a leading Brazilian food company with a strong heritage, recognized brands, and a growing international footprint. As the company expands its operations in the U.S. and Europe, financial governance, liquidity control, and operational excellence are critical to sustaining growth. We offer a collaborative environment with high exposure, autonomy, and direct interaction with senior leadership.

About the role

This is a highly specialized international treasury role, designed for a senior, autonomous professional.

The International Treasury Specialist will operate independently, owning treasury, cash flow, and international banking operations across the United States, United Kingdom, and Europe.

This is not a transactional AP role.

It is a position with low payment volume but very high operational and compliance complexity, requiring strong judgment, technical depth, and end-to-end ownership.

Key responsibilities

Cash Flow & Liquidity Management

  • Build, manage, and continuously monitor short- and medium-term cash flow forecasts (including 13-week cash flow)
  • Ensure liquidity and funding availability for international operations
  • Analyze variances, assumptions, and scenarios impacting cash position

International Payments & Banking Operations

  • Execute and manage international payments across U.S. and European banking systems
  • Operate payment methods such as ACH, SWIFT, SEPA, wire transfers, and international payroll-related payments
  • Navigate banking environments without PIX or boletos
  • Manage FX transactions, payment cut-offs, bank holidays, and country-specific rules
  • Maintain strong relationships with international banks and service providers
  • Negotiate banking fees and service conditions when applicable

Accounts Payable, Receivable & Governance

  • Own the end-to-end international AP and AR flows, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timeliness
  • Partner with Accounting and local providers (e.g., Portugal accounting team) for validation and execution
  • Ensure payments align with accounting, tax, and contractual requirements
  • Apply strong governance, internal controls, and compliance standards

Cross-functional Partnership

  • Work closely with HR (international payrolls and benefits), Marketing (costs and campaigns), Accounting, FP&A, and Commercial
  • Understand accounting classifications (OPEX vs. CAPEX) and financial impacts
  • Act as a key finance partner in international operations

Profile we are looking for

  • A senior, autonomous, and highly reliable professional
  • Comfortable operating alone, without constant follow-ups
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Able to manage complex international routines with precision
  • Hands-on, detail-oriented, and resilient in a corporate governance environment
  • Strong communication skills to interact with global stakeholders

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, Finance, or related fields
  • Fluent English (mandatory / non-negotiable)
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in Treasury or International Finance
  • Proven experience with international payments, especially in the U.S.
  • Solid knowledge of cash flow management (build, monitor, analyze)
  • Strong understanding of financial mathematics
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Experience with ERP systems (SAP and/or Datasul – TOTVS)
  • Strong understanding of corporate governance and compliance

Nice to have

  • Experience with European banking operations
  • Spanish proficiency
  • Prior exposure to multinational or international business environments

Why join Forno de Minas

  • Strategic international role with high visibility
  • Opportunity to build and structure international treasury operations
  • High level of autonomy and trust
  • Direct interaction with senior leadership
  • Exposure to global financial operations and decision-making

Descrição da Empresa: Somos um Hospital veterinário pioneiro em medicina veterinária de excelência, localizado na cidade de Eunápolis , extremo sul da Bahia . Fundados em 2016 , somos referência no mercado com alta credibilidade da marca pelo trabalho sério e qualificado . Nosso grupo apresenta crescimento anual progressivo comprovado . Acreditamos que somente com profissionais qualificados conseguiremos manter o nosso padrão de excelência de atendimento e oferecer ao nossos pacientes a medicina veterinária avançada .

Descrição do Cargo Estamos à procura de um Veterinário Intensivista para atuar no setor de internação no Hospital Veterinário IntensiVita, localizado em Eunápolis, BA. Este profissional será responsável por supervisionar e realizar o atendimento clínico intensivo de animais internados, acompanhar e ajustar os planos de cuidado, administrar medicações e realizar procedimentos clínicos necessários para garantir a saúde e o bem-estar dos pacientes. Este é um cargo presencial e a contratação será sob regime de contrato entre empresas com CNPJ ativo.

Qualificações

  • Atendimento Clínico: Experiência em cuidados críticos, administração de medicamentos e realização de procedimentos médicos em ambientes de internação.
  • Controle e Monitoramento: Conhecimento em monitoramento de sinais vitais e utilização de equipamentos específicos de terapia intensiva.
  • Gestão e Comunicação: Capacidade de colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, excelente comunicação com tutores e relatórios claros sobre o estado de saúde dos pacientes.
  • São diferenciais: especialização ou cursos em cuidados intensivos veterinários, e atualização contínua em práticas veterinárias.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.

Responsibilities

Sales Operations

  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data

Services Operations

  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems

CRM and Systems Administration

  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards

Data and Reporting

  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Contracts

  • Track and respond to internal questions regarding contract terms, pricing, and commercial conditions, partnering closely with Finance and Legal as needed.
  • Support contract lifecycle management by monitoring stated terms and addressing internal stakeholder inquiries to ensure accuracy and compliance.

Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
description:
ZTE is looking for Regulatory Affairs & Product Certification Manager

Role Purpose

We are seeking a senior Regulatory Affairs & Product Certification Manager to act as the single owner and authority for all Anatel regulatory compliance and product certification activities in Brazil.

This role is critical to ensuring the company's ability to import, commercialize, deploy, and operate telecommunications products in the Brazilian market, while enabling speed-to-market, commercial competitiveness, and long-term regulatory sustainability.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership, strong interaction with Global HQ, and direct influence on revenue, deployment, and customer trust.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the full lifecycle of Anatel homologation and product certification activities, including planning, execution, publication, maintenance, renewals, and amendments.
  • Act as the single point of accountability with Anatel, OCDs (Designated Certification Bodies), and accredited laboratories.
  • Define and execute regulatory strategies per product family, balancing compliance, cost efficiency, risk mitigation, and time-to-market.
  • Coordinate and validate all regulatory and technical documentation, including test reports, declarations of conformity, manuals in Portuguese, and technical files.
  • Assess the regulatory impact of hardware, firmware, RF, and configuration changes, enforcing regulatory gates and blocking deployments when compliance is at risk.
  • Ensure strict alignment between certified configurations and field-deployed products, SKUs, and software versions.
  • Support Sales, Pre-Sales, Post-Sales, and Supply Chain with regulatory validation for RFPs, RFQs, imports, and network deployments.
  • Maintain an audit-ready regulatory repository and manage interactions with Anatel during audits, inspections, and formal inquiries.
  • Monitor homologation validity dates and proactively manage renewals to prevent service disruption or import blocks.
  • Continuously improve certification lead time, cost efficiency, and regulatory predictability through optimization strategies.

Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration

  • Interface directly with Global Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Product Engineering, Test & Certification, Supply Chain, Legal, and Commercial teams.
  • Translate global product roadmaps and engineering changes into Brazilian regulatory requirements and execution plans.
  • Act as the internal regulatory authority and trusted advisor on Brazilian telecommunications regulations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in regulatory affairs, product certification, or compliance within the telecommunications industry.
  • Proven hands-on experience with Anatel homologation processes, especially for Class III (network infrastructure) equipment.
  • Strong understanding of RF fundamentals, EMC, electrical safety, and telecom network technologies (RAN, MW, IP, Optical, CPE).
  • English as primary working language is mandatory; Portuguese fluency is required; Advanced Mandarin is desirable.
  • Ability to operate autonomously with strong ownership, sound judgment, and assertive decision-making.

What Success Looks Like

Zero expired or non-compliant homologations.

No import blocks or deployment delays caused by regulatory issues.

Reduced certification lead time and re-test costs.

Full regulatory visibility and predictability for leadership, engineering, and sales.

Recognition as the internal authority on Anatel and Brazilian telecom regulation.

Why This Role Matters

This is strategic, technical, and business-critical role when you can face challenge and develop yourself.

Without regulatory compliance, products do not enter the country and networks do not go live.

With strong regulatory leadership, the company operates faster, safer, and more competitively in Brazil.

Are you interested in being part of our team? Please apply for this opportunity and attach your resume in English. Kindly note that only English resumes will be considered.

title: DevOps Engineer - Sr. Associate
description:
About the Company

Credit Saison Brazil ("CSBR") is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early-stage start-up investment and M&A/joint venture.

Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan's largest non-bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.

Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you're passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi-cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.

About the Role

Cloud Infrastructure & Orchestration

  • Architect and manage container platforms (AWS ECS or EKS) ensuring scalability, high availability, and fault tolerance critical for financial transactions.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform or CloudFormation to standardize environments and ensure reproducibility across development, staging, and production.
  • Manage AWS Networking components (VPCs, Subnets, Transit Gateways, Route 53, Load Balancers) with a focus on network segregation and security best practices.

CI/CD & Automation

  • Design and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines to support agile software delivery while enforcing strict quality gates and security checks.
  • Automate operational tasks using Python or Bash to reduce manual intervention and operational risk.
  • Drive the "Shift-Left" approach, integrating testing and security scanning early in the development lifecycle.

Observability, Reliability & Performance

  • Configure and maintain comprehensive observability solutions (APM, dashboards, distributed tracing, and centralized logging) to ensure real-time visibility into system health.
  • Proactively monitor application performance and infrastructure metrics to prevent incidents and optimize resource utilization.
  • Define and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Error Budgets to maintain the reliability required for a 24/7 financial operation.

Security, Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure secure container lifecycles, managing ECR (Image Registry) with strict vulnerability scanning and patching routines for third-party and internal images.
  • Implement security controls and access management (IAM) aligned with financial regulatory standards (e.g., BACEN, LGPD) and audit requirements.
  • Collaborate with the Security team to implement immutable infrastructure and ensure audit trails for all infrastructure changes.

Requirements

  • Native or bilingual proficiency in Portuguese and Professional English (technical reading and writing are essential).
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Cloud Engineering roles.
  • Solid knowledge of Python and proficiency in Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation.
  • Deep proficiency in Docker, container orchestration (ECS or EKS), and Helm.
  • Experience with AWS networking architecture and security groups.
  • Practical experience with APM tools (e.g., Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace) and logging stacks (ELK, Splunk, CloudWatch).

Differentiators (Nice to have)

  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional or Solutions Architect Professional.
  • CKA/CKAD (Kubernetes) Certification.
  • Prior experience in the Financial Sector (FinTechs, Banks, Payments), specifically dealing with regulatory requirements and critical mission environments.
  • Experience with GitOps workflows (e.g., ArgoCD).

title: Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - Motrice - Soluções ESG
description:

O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

A Motrice é uma empresa especializada em soluções agroindustriais inovadoras e agregadoras de valor para gestão ambiental e economia circular, com percepção e foco no potencial de também transformar resíduos orgânicos urbanos em produtos de alto valor agregado. Utilizando tecnologias limpas e processos acelerados, a empresa desenvolverá sistemas capazes de converter resíduos em fertilizantes e regeneradores de solo de forma muito mais rápida e eficiente do que a compostagem tradicional, além de oferecer alternativas economicamente mais viáveis que o envio para aterros sanitários. Sua atuação integra princípios ESG, promovendo redução de impactos ambientais, reaproveitamento inteligente de resíduos e apoio à regeneração dos solos, contribuindo diretamente para cidades mais sustentáveis e cadeias produtivas de baixo carbono. A Motrice possui em Curitiba uma Planta Piloto equipada para dar pleno suporte ao desenvolvimento do projeto.

Projeto: Soluções ESG.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo em Bioengenharia, Bioinformática, Bioquímica, Biologia, Engenharia de Processos, Engenharia Química, Agronomia ou áreas correlatas

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Principais Atividades:

  • Desenvolvimento, testes e validação da engenharia de processos, utilizando conhecimentos de física, química e biologia;
  • Estruturar indicadores técnicos e econômicos, mapear possibilidades de escalabilidade e apoiar estratégias de inclusão de catadores, educação ambiental e redesenho de arranjos produtivos locais.

  • Desenvolvimento de processos físico, químico e biológicos, avaliação agronômica, gestão de resíduos sólidos urbanos, inclusão produtiva

  • Design de experimentos (DOE), modelagem de processos, análise de ciclo de vida (ACV), arranjos produtivos locais (APL), capacitação técnica e integração social

Formato de trabalho: Híbrido – Curitiba/PR (integração e sempre que houver atividade de laboratório)

Soft Skills: Liderança, Autonomia, Pensamento Crítico, Ética e Responsabilidade.

title: Gerente de contas | Cuiabá/MT
description:
Unidade de Negócio: Sem Parar Empresas

Modelo de trabalho: Presencial

Missão da área: Conectar empresas a soluções inovadoras de mobilidade e gestão, impulsionando a eficiência e a produtividade por meio do portfólio Sem Parar Empresas. Nosso compromisso é oferecer um atendimento consultivo e estratégico, garantindo a melhor experiência para os clientes e contribuindo para o crescimento sustentável do negócio.

Objetivos do cargo que você irá atuar: Como Gerentes de contas você será responsável por vender o portfólio Sem Parar Empresas, oferecendo soluções de abastecimento de acordo com a necessidade de cada cliente. Além disso, será responsável por inserir informações no Salesforce, construir o funil de vendas, abrir novos mercados e buscar novas oportunidades. Também deverá gerir o pipeline, manter um fluxo de vendas consistente e acompanhar as implantações, com o objetivo de atingir as metas de receita inicial.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar contato ágil com os leads recebidos por meio dos canais disponíveis (telefone, e-mail e WhatsApp), atuando na qualificação e conversão de oportunidades.
  • Conduzir reuniões presenciais e virtuais com prospects e clientes para levantamento de necessidades, entendimento do projeto e apresentação de soluções personalizadas.
  • Registrar todas as interações comerciais (ligações, e-mails e reuniões) no Salesforce, garantindo organização e rastreabilidade das informações.
  • Criar e gerenciar oportunidades no Salesforce, elaborar propostas comerciais, realizar follow-ups estratégicos e atuar ativamente no fechamento das negociações.
  • Acompanhar o processo de implantação, assegurando o início da operação conforme contratado e a satisfação do cliente.
  • Gerenciar o funil de vendas, mantendo previsões realistas e controle das etapas das oportunidades.
  • Garantir a conclusão das vendas por meio do acompanhamento remoto ou presencial dos clientes, monitorando o fluxo de utilização para impulsionar o crescimento e o faturamento da carteira.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas internas, especialmente com o time de pós-vendas, garantindo alinhamento e excelência na jornada do cliente.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior cursando ou completo.
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas e gestão de funil de vendas.
  • CNH categoria B válida.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.
  • Vivência em vendas B2B, preferencialmente com meios de pagamento.

Informações adicionais

Fique por dentro do que te oferecemos:

  • Vale-alimentação ou Vale-refeição — você escolhe uma das duas modalidades;
  • Veículo corporativo;
  • Auxílio combustível;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Telemedicina — Disponível 24h por dia, todos os dias da semana;
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass);
  • PLR (Participação nos Lucros e Resultados, de acordo com a política vigente);
  • Day off de aniversário — Folga no seu aniversário e também no aniversário da empresa;

  • Incentivo educacional — até 25% de desconto em pós-graduação ou MBA;

title: Supervisor de contabilidade
description:
DM Descafeinadores do Brasil S/A

Vaga: Supervisor de Contabilidade

Local: Sooretama/ES

Inauguramos nossa nova fábrica de descafeinização, a DM Brasil, e estamos em busca de um(a) Supervisor(a) de Contabilidade para integrar nosso time e liderar processos estratégicos em um dos setores mais inovadores e desafiadores do mercado.

Descrição da posição:

Responsável por supervisionar e garantir a correta execução das rotinas contábeis e fiscais da indústria de café, assegurando conformidade com a legislação vigente e precisão das informações financeiras, através do cumprimento dos procedimentos financeiros, monitorando com rigor os parâmetros fiscais e contábeis, observando os indicadores e prazos estabelecidos, visando sempre à qualidade e acuracidade das informações, à boa interação com a equipe.

Suas responsabilidades incluirão:

  • Supervisionar as rotinas de escrituração contábil, conciliações e fechamento, tanto livro corrente como diferido.
  • Operações de hedge de commodity e moeda, marcação a mercado de operações de derivativos e estoque.
  • Garantir a correta classificação e análise das contas patrimoniais e de resultado.
  • Suporte as demonstrações financeiras (Balanço Patrimonial, DRE, DFC, entre outras).
  • Domínio das normas contábeis (CPC/IFRS).
  • Apoiar auditorias internas, externas e departamento de controles internos, fornecendo informações e esclarecimentos.
  • Supervisionar lançamentos de ativos imobilizados, depreciação e estoques industriais.
  • Atuar de forma direta no controle de custos fixos e variáveis da planta industrial.
  • Supervisionar a apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos (ICMS, PIS, COFINS, IRPJ, CSLL, entre outros).
  • Acompanhar desdobramentos da reforma tributária, identificando os principais impactos e participando das discussões internas.
  • Conhecimento das obrigações acessórias, apoiando o departamento responsável por essas atividades.
  • Acompanhar e interpretar a legislação fiscal aplicável à indústria alimentícia e ao setor cafeeiro.
  • Identificar oportunidades de planejamento tributário, dentro da legalidade.
  • Atuar no atendimento a fiscalizações e auditorias fiscais.

O que buscamos:

  • Formação em Ciências Contábeis - CRC Ativo
  • Excel em nível intermediário/avançado.
  • Sistemas ERP - experiência com ERP Industrial será um diferencial.
  • Inglês e/ou espanhol nível avançado.
  • Experiência em operações de commodity agrícola.
  • Vivência em indústrias, preferencialmente no segmento alimentício ou agroindustrial.
  • Residência na região de Sooretama ou Linhares é imprescindível.

O que oferecemos:

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Restaurante no local;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Participação nos Lucros (PLR);
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Vale Natal;

Remuneração: Salário compatível com o mercado.

Se você é apaixonado por desafios e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que valoriza inovação e excelência, candidate-se agora mesmo!

title: Logistics Manager (CVs in Portuguese not accepted)
description:

realme has been devoted to let young users around the world enjoy tech experiences that exceed expectations. Upon the establishment of realme in 2018, we never stopped outdoing ourselves in terms of branding, product performance, design, quality and customer service. As the world's fastest-growing smartphone brand, we have been operating in 61 markets globally, including China, India, Southeast Asia, Europe, Latin America, the Middle East and Africa, with the total of over 200 million users across the globe.

*Work from office position*

The logistics manager will be responsible for leading end-to-end logistics, warehouse, and delivery operations for the Brazil subsidiary. The position ensures operational efficiency, cost optimization, and full compliance with internal controls and external regulations to guarantee accurate inventory levels and timely product delivery to customers.

Your responsibilities

  • Manage the warehouse and delivery operations, ensuring accurate warehouse inventory records, timely local deliveries, smooth customs clearance, and secure business operations to meet customer delivery requirements.
  • Assist in supplier certification, on-site management, and procurement to ensure the implementation of cost reduction initiatives.
  • Identify delivery risks and exceptions, and drive resolution and improvement; regularly report delivery and inventory status to the sales team.
  • Timely verification and reimbursement of logistics expenses, along with cost analysis and improvement suggestions.

Requirement for the position

Subbmit your CV in English please

  • Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or related areas.
  • Postgraduate specialization (MBA, Logistics, Operations) is considered an advantage.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in logistics, warehouse operations, supply chain, or related roles.
  • Strong experience managing outsourced warehouse partners and last-mile delivery providers.
  • Hands-on involvement in inventory control, import logistics, and customs processes.
  • Previous experience in consumer electronics, retail, FMCG, or high-volume product categories is an advantage.
  • Fluency in English required; additional languages (e.g., Mandarin, Spanish, Portuguese) are a plus.
  • Experience in companies in the initial phase of operation in Brazil (stage 0→1), especially in contexts of rapid expansion is a plus

Você ingressará no nosso Programa para Formação de Novos Corretores, onde aprenderá tudo sobre Seguro de Vida e Previdência. Realizará o curso preparatório para o exame de Habilitação Técnico Profissional e, ao ser aprovado, terá sua licença para atuar como Corretor de Seguros, começando o seu próprio negócio, com todo o suporte e expertise da MAG Seguros.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Você atuará como profissional autônomo com as seguintes atribuições:
  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep;
Após a conquista da Habilitação:
  • Identificará potenciais clientes para abordar, utilizando sua Rede de Relacionamento para agendamento de entrevistas de vendas e solicitação de indicações;
  • Fará telemarketing ativo para agendar entrevistas de vendas;
  • Realizará as entrevistas de vendas, identificando as necessidades de proteção financeira do prospect e ofertando as soluções mais adequadas a cada perfil;
  • Gerenciará a sua carteira de clientes com foco na sustentabilidade financeira do seu negócio.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Aptidão para vendas;
  • Amplo círculo social (network/ rede de relacionamento);
  • Perfil ativo nas redes sociais;
Você se diferenciará, se possuir:
  • Experiência como profissional autônomo, liberal ou empreendedor;
  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.
Informações adicionais
PESSOAS BEM-SUCEDIDAS NESSA PROFISSÃO:
  • São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio;
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam;
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social;
  • Possuem como prioridades o sucesso profissional e os ganhos financeiros, independente de regime de contratação de trabalho;
  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, possuindo flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais;
  • Atuam com disciplina no planejamento semanal das atividades de vendas, de acordo com os parâmetros necessários para o atingimento e superação dos objetivos financeiros e pessoais;
  • Dedicam-se ao estudo contínuo em busca de novos conhecimentos, mantendo-se atualizadas profissionalmente.
Já pensou em redirecionar sua carreira ou aprender uma nova profissão?
Agora imagine só, poder fazer isso sendo parceiro de uma empresa que, há quase 200 anos, ajuda as pessoas a planejar um futuro financeiro mais tranquilo. Aqui na MAG, nossos corretores parceiros são chamados de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira.
E se você tem tino comercial, gosta de se relacionar com pessoas, tem perfil empreendedor e deseja trabalhar com o forte propósito de prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros, nosso Programa para Formação de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira é a oportunidade ideal para você!
Sabemos bem que um processo de mudança de carreira pode ser algo difícil. Mas, participando de nosso Programa, você terá todo o suporte necessário para ser bem sucedido, desde o treinamento em sala de aula - onde aprenderá mais sobre a empresa, seu portfólio e o processo de vendas – até o acompanhamento em campo, onde realizará - com a supervisão de nossos líderes especialistas - as primeiras entrevistas de vendas.
Conheça as vantagens de se tornar Especialistas em Proteção Financeira parceiro da MAG Seguros:
  • Além de toda estrutura de suporte, treinamento e acompanhamento, poderemos apoiá-lo financeiramente na fase inicial de constituição de seu negócio, mediante o atingimento de critérios mínimos de produtividade.
  • Subsídios de até 70% para adquirir produtos como plano de saúde, de telefonia móvel, seguros de vida, notebook e smartphone, mediante elegibilidade ao nosso Programa de Fidelidade
  • Comissionamento vitalício sobre grande parte das coberturas comercializadas, ou seja, a comissão é do corretor pelo tempo em que o contrato do cliente estiver ativo, permitindo ganhos ilimitados.
  • Atuação presencial, com relacionamento multicanal, que pode ser realizado via unidades de vendas, telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail e chat, além de portal exclusivo para corretores.
  • Campanhas de vendas periódicas, que premiam os vencedores, além do reconhecimento e distinção, com incríveis viagens de turismo ou de desenvolvimento. Acesse vida.mag.com.br/mag-365.
  • Conversão das vendas em pontos que podem ser trocados por mais de 50 mil itens disponíveis em um catálogo virtual.
Sobre a MAG
Com mais de 6 milhões de clientes e cerca de R$ 475 bilhões assegurados, somos especialistas no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas em seguros de vida e planos de previdência individuais e corporativos. Em 2009, nos associamos ao Grupo Aegon, presente em mais de 20 países ao redor do mundo.

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You'll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You'll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.

What You'll Do

· Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

· Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

· Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

· Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

· Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

· Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

· Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap

Requirements (Must-Haves)

· Fluent English (written and spoken); confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

· 5+ years in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

· Solution engineering capability in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

· You've contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

· Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

· Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

· Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

· Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

· Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

· Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

· Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

· Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

· Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

· Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product

Location & Working Hours

· Brazil-based (fully remote)

· Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET) working hours

What We Offer

· Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

· Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

· Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

· High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

· Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings

How to Apply

Submit your CV in English, and one paragraph describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client's go-live in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Quality Manager - Wind Project Delivery
description:
Quality Manager LATAM - Wind Projects

  • Based in São Paulo, Brazil
  • Full time position, hybrid work set-up

The Quality Manager is responsible for establishing, implementing, and overseeing quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) systems for onshore wind projects. This role ensures that all construction, installation, and commissioning activities comply with company standards, contractual requirements, OEM specifications, and Brazilian regulations.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, implement, and maintain the project quality management plan, procedures, and inspection & test plans (ITPs) for wind farm projects.
  • Lead site QA/QC activities across civil works, foundations, towers, nacelles, blades, electrical balance of plant, and substations.
  • Coordinate and supervise inspections, tests, and audits; ensure proper documentation, non-conformance reporting (NCR), and timely corrective actions.
  • Review and approve quality documentation from EPCs, subcontractors, and OEMs (method statements, welding procedures, material certificates, FAT/SAT reports).
  • Monitor construction and installation quality, ensuring work is executed according to drawings, specifications, and OEM standards.
  • Manage NCRs, root cause analyses, and preventive measures; track and close punch lists and quality-related defects.
  • Interface with engineering, HSE, construction management, and suppliers to resolve quality issues and improve processes.
  • Ensure traceability and proper record keeping of materials, inspections, and tests for handover to operations and for warranty purposes.
  • Prepare regular quality reports (KPIs, NCR trends, audit findings) for senior management and project stakeholders.
  • Provide training and guidance to site teams and subcontractors on quality standards, procedures, and best practices.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical) or related discipline.
  • Several years of experience in QA/QC or quality management within wind, power generation, or large infrastructure projects.
  • Strong knowledge of quality management systems (e.g. ISO 9001) and relevant standards for civil, mechanical, and electrical works.
  • Familiarity with wind turbine technology, foundations, lifting/installation processes, and HV/MV systems.
  • Experience leading audits, inspections, and managing NCR and corrective action processes.
  • Proficient in technical documentation, reporting, and use of digital quality/inspection tools.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills; able to challenge and support contractors constructively.
  • Fluency in English ideal

title: Backoffice ACL (Operações Processos)

Sobre a Ótima Energia

A Ótima Energia atua no Mercado Livre de Energia (ACL) ajudando empresas a tomar decisões melhores, com clareza, transparência e execução impecável. Nosso diferencial é processo: organizamos informação, estruturamos o fluxo com comercializadoras parceiras e garantimos que cada etapa avance de forma correta e rastreável.

Sobre a função

Estamos buscando uma pessoa de Backoffice ACL para ser o braço operacional do time comercial.

Seu papel é garantir que cada oportunidade avance com rapidez e organização: documentação certa, RFQs enviados no padrão de cada parceiro, cotações acompanhadas até chegar, propostas montadas no portal e handoff para fechamento sem ruído.

O perfil ideal é obcecado por processo. Alguém que gosta de checklist, planejamento, documentação e padrão.

Principais responsabilidades

Montar e manter o "dossiê" do cliente no portal (contas, UC, dados essenciais), garantindo qualidade e consistência.

Preparar e disparar pedidos de cotação (RFQs) para comercializadoras parceiras no formato exigido por cada uma (e-mail, portal, WhatsApp etc.).

Fazer follow-up ativo para cobrar cotações, controlar SLAs e garantir retorno no prazo.

Registrar e organizar as ofertas recebidas no portal, garantindo que estejam completas e comparáveis.

Acompanhar o andamento dos contratos após escolha do cliente, incluindo marcos operacionais como supply live / ativação e status relacionado à CCEE quando aplicável.

Manter controles e relatórios operacionais (pipeline, prazos, status de propostas, etapas do processo).

Apoiar o dia a dia do fundador e do time com atividades operacionais importantes do negócio, sempre com foco em execução e melhoria de processos.

Perfil desejado

Requisitos obrigatórios

Inglês avançado (100% obrigatório). Você vai precisar ler, escrever e conversar com segurança.

Organização extrema, atenção a detalhes e disciplina para seguir e melhorar processos.

Conforto com tecnologia e ferramentas (CRM, planilhas, sistemas, portais, fluxos).

Capacidade de documentar e padronizar rotinas (SOPs, checklists, playbooks).

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

Experiência com Mercado Livre (ACL), comercializadoras, backoffice, migração ou rotinas operacionais do setor elétrico.

Perfil "mão na massa" e ritmo de startup.

Interesse por tecnologia e melhoria contínua.

O que oferecemos

Ambiente enxuto, com autonomia e responsabilidade real.

Trabalho diretamente ligado ao que faz a empresa crescer.

Estrutura de ferramentas e sistemas já construída para facilitar execução e escala.

Equipamentos de trabalho fornecidos pela empresa (notebook e o necessário para a função).

Envie seu CV para:

Assunto do e-mail (obrigatório):

(BACKOFFICE ACL) Nome Sobrenome — RJ — PJ

No corpo do e-mail, responda (pode ser curto):

Em 5 linhas, como você organiza um processo com muitas etapas e dependências (ex.: checklist, prazos, follow-up).

title: Analista de Remuneração e Benefícios PL/SR
description:
Muito prazer, Somos a Evertec!

A Evertec é uma empresa especializada em tecnologia para o setor financeiro, com mais de 27 anos de atuação e presença em 26 países da América Latina e Caribe. Com mais de 11 bilhões de transações processadas anualmente, somos referência em soluções que impulsionam a transformação digital do mercado.

Oferecemos um portfólio completo de soluções em software, atendendo instituições financeiras, empresas e fintechs que buscam inovação, segurança e eficiência.

Nosso compromisso é com a excelência tecnológica, a inclusão financeira e a geração de valor sustentável para clientes, colaboradores e parceiros, promovendo um ecossistema mais conectado e acessível.

A área de Remuneração é responsável por implementar e manter políticas e práticas salariais que garantam competitividade, equidade interna e alinhamento com a estratégia da empresa, e busca um Analista de Remuneração e Benefícios SR para compor nosso time, na maior empresa de desenvolvimento de softwares e produtos para o mercado financeiro do Brasil, onde acreditamos que a inovação tecnológica inspira a evolução

Esse cargo será responsável por:

  • Desenhar, manter e governar a arquitetura de cargos (Levels, trilhas de carreira), garantindo equidade interna e competitividade externa.
  • Liderar o ciclo anual de revisão salarial, definindo diretrizes, elegibilidade, budgets, regras de exceção e prazos
  • Orquestrar o Ciclo Anual de Remuneração: planejamento, comunicação, calibragens, aprovações, execução e pós-mortem.
  • Monitorar tendências de mercado (benefícios emergentes, incentivos, premiações) e sugerir inovações alinhadas ao perfil da empresa.
  • Contribuir para PPR (regras, metas corporativas, comunicação, cálculo, auditoria) e incentivos de curto e longo prazo (STI/LTI).
  • Garantir aderência à legislação trabalhista, políticas internas e auditorias (internas/externas), mantendo trilhas de evidência.
  • Realizar análises preditivas (risco de evasão por gap de mercado, elasticidade de retenção, impactos de ajustes) e apresentar insights acionáveis.
  • Atuar como especialista consultivo, orientando líderes e Business Partners em propostas de contratação, movimentações internas e retenções.
  • Mapear e otimizar processos críticos (ciclos, aprovações, integrações com folha, reporting), com foco em agilidade e auditabilidade.
  • Apoiar gestão de mudança em alterações de políticas, revisões de faixas, atualizações de programas de incentivo.
  • Elaborar materiais de comunicação para líderes e colaboradores (guides, FAQs, políticas, comunicados), com linguagem clara e objetiva.

Para dar #match, essa vaga necessita que atenda alguns requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas correlatas;
  • Excel intermediário a avançado;
  • Ter atuando diretamente com Remuneração / Cargos & Salários / C&B / People Analytics de Remuneração em empresa média/grande ou consultoria;
  • Entendimento de CCTs (Convenções Coletivas) e impacto em cargos/faixas/benefícios quando aplicável;
  • Capacidade de traduzir dados em recomendações práticas, influenciando decisões de negócio com base em evidências.

Caso possua o conhecimento ou atuação abaixo, será um diferencial:
